solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cutter was turning jade first

indicators.note: first tells us the jade piece leads, ahead of the other piece

parts.note: to jade is to tire out, as does to hack (a worn-out horse is a hack or a jade)

indicators.note: turning signals that the word was is read backwards

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a piece of jade was being turned before it was cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jade' looks like the green stone, but here it is the verb to tire out; 'turning' and 'first' fix the order of the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw for metal is a tool that cuts, so it is a cutter.

clue.text: The woman's promiscuous — not a minority view

parts.note: her is the woman's, the possessive pronoun

indicators.note: not tells us the letter a is to be left out of the preceding word

parts.note: easy is a slang word for promiscuous
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gossip claims a woman is promiscuous, then denies it is a minority view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'promiscuous' is slang usage; 'not a' strips one letter from that slang word before it joins the pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: Heresy is an opinion at odds with the accepted one, held by few.

clue.text: Herbivore eating everything that's green

indicators.note: eating means the herbivore takes the other piece inside it

parts.note: a cow is a grass-eating animal
everything means all

explanation.surface: A grazing animal munches all the green stuff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'green' looks like grass for the herbivore, but it means inexperienced.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone young and inexperienced, a synonym pair.

clue.text: Rap cults mad about religious instruction according to the Bible

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go around the other piece
mad suggests the letters of rap cults are crazily rearranged

parts.note: anagram fodder
RI is the abbreviation for religious instruction, a school subject in Britain

explanation.surface: Cults of rap music are crazy about teaching faith from the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mad' turns RAP CULTS into SCPTURAL; 'about' puts RI inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Scriptural means based on or found in Scripture, the Bible.

clue.text: Island where boat crew changes direction at the start

indicators.note: the first letter, a compass point east, is swapped for another compass point, west

parts.note: a rowing eight is a boat crew of eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: On an island, the rowing crew turns round at the start of the race.
explanation.walkthrough: E (east) at the start of EIGHT becomes W (west). The Isle of Wight is an island off England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Wight is an English island in the Channel.

clue.text: Fool of a son taken in by knaves

indicators.note: taken in by means the son goes inside the other piece

parts.note: the knave in a pack of cards is also called the jack
S is the abbreviation for son, as in family trees

explanation.surface: A foolish son is cheated by rogues.
explanation.walkthrough: Knave and jack are the same playing card.
explanation.definitionFit: A jackass is slang for a stupid person, a fool.

clue.text: One widely travelled black dog

parts.note: jet is a deep black, as in jet-black
a setter is a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: A black dog has travelled the world.
explanation.definitionFit: A jet-setter is a wealthy person who flies around the world for pleasure.

clue.text: Company taking care of palm tree

parts.note: c/o is the abbreviation for care of, used on letters

explanation.surface: A firm looks after a palm tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The coco is the coconut palm, a tropical tree.

clue.text: Directed a chartered accountant to make cutback in universities

indicators.note: cutback read as cut back tells us the whole run is turned around

parts.note: aimed means directed
taken as written

explanation.surface: An accountant is told to make budget cuts in universities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to make cutback' reverses AIMED A CA, giving the whole answer backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Academia is the world of higher learning, universities collectively.

clue.text: List including first of down clues he rehashed

indicators.note: including means the rearranged letters take the other piece inside
rehashed means the words clues and he are reworked into a new order

parts.note: anagram fodder
anagram fodder

indicators.note: first of means just the opening letter of down

explanation.surface: A setter rehashes the down clues into a list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rehashed' signals the anagram and 'including' sets the single letter from 'first of down' into the rearranged word; the surface pretends to describe the setter's own clues.
explanation.definitionFit: A schedule is a timetable or list of planned items.

clue.text: Being in charge one needs to be straight

definitions.meaning: a being, or person, who governs a country
a measuring stick with a straight edge for drawing lines

explanation.definitionFit: Ruler means both a sovereign and a straight-edged measuring tool.

clue.text: Person investigating artist has cut round to enter uninvited

indicators.note: round means the cut goes around the other pieces

parts.note: a gash is a cut
tec is short for detective
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A detective finds that an artist has a cut on the head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Person investigating' is a long way of saying detective, shortened in crosswords; 'round' wraps the cut around detective plus artist.
explanation.definitionFit: To gatecrash is to attend a party without an invitation.

clue.text: Athlete has try to join club

parts.note: a shot is an attempt, a try
a putter is a golf club

explanation.surface: A sportsman has a go at joining a club.
explanation.definitionFit: A shot-putter is a field athlete who throws the heavy ball.

clue.text: Wild plant may be watered!

definitions.meaning: an unwanted plant growing where it is not wanted

explanation.definitionFit: Weed is a wild plant, and also a past form of the slang verb to wee.

clue.text: Kansas belt turned out abnormally tall plants

indicators.note: turned out suggests the letters are turned into a new arrangement

parts.note: anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A belt across Kansas produced remarkably tall crops.
explanation.definitionFit: Beanstalks, as in the fairy tale, are pictured as reaching to the sky.

clue.text: Common freedom enjoyed by Dusty

definitions.meaning: Dusty is the traditional nickname for anyone surnamed Miller, so his freedom is the run of his workplace

explanation.walkthrough: Dusty Miller is a stock British nickname: a miller is covered in flour dust.
explanation.definitionFit: Run-of-the-mill means ordinary, unremarkable.

clue.text: Artillery keeping independent regulation

indicators.note: keeping means the artillery holds the other piece inside

parts.note: ordnance means military guns, artillery

explanation.surface: The artillery stays independent of regulation.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordinance is an official rule or decree, a regulation.

clue.text: What's fallen out from small sack

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing
to sack a town is to pillage it

explanation.surface: Something has fallen out of a little bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sack' looks like a bag; it means plunder.
explanation.definitionFit: Spillage is the quantity that has been spilt.

clue.text: Landlord with infestation seen redeveloping

parts.note: lice are a typical infestation

indicators.note: redeveloping means the letters of seen are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A landlord with an infestation is seen redeveloping his property.
explanation.definitionFit: A licensee is the holder of a pub licence, the landlord in Britain.

clue.text: The royal couple in grand flirtation

parts.note: Phil and ER: Prince Philip and Elizabeth Regina
G is short for grand, a thousand pounds

explanation.surface: The Queen and her husband flirt in grand style.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is Elizabeth Regina; G is a grand (a thousand pounds).
explanation.definitionFit: Philandering is casual womanising, a form of flirtation.

clue.text: Something valuable in one's house

parts.note: a gem is a precious thing
I is the Roman numeral one; the 's means is

explanation.surface: Something valuable is in somebody's home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'house' is the astrological sense: one of the twelve divisions of the zodiac.
explanation.definitionFit: Gemini is a zodiac sign, each sign ruling an astrological house.

clue.text: Police leader once detaining first of race horses

indicators.note: detaining means the singer holds the other piece inside

parts.note: Sting was the frontman of the band The Police

indicators.note: first of means only the opening letter of race

explanation.surface: A former police chief holds the first horses of a race.
explanation.walkthrough: The Police were a rock band; Sting led them.
explanation.definitionFit: A string is the stable of horses owned or trained by one person.

clue.text: German song was deceptive

definitions.meaning: a Romantic art song in German

explanation.definitionFit: A Lied is a German song; lied is also the past tense of lie.

clue.text: Dressed like priest, one may get profit

definitions.meaning: money put into a venture to earn a return

explanation.definitionFit: An investment is a stake laid out in hope of profit.

clue.text: Feel sorry for headless bird

indicators.note: headless means the first letter is cut off

parts.note: to regret is to feel sorry for

explanation.surface: Someone pities a bird that has lost its head.
explanation.definitionFit: An egret is a white heron, a wading bird.

clue.text: Decline old pudding

parts.note: to sag is to decline or droop

explanation.surface: Someone refuses an old-fashioned dessert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Decline' looks like refuse; it means sink.
explanation.definitionFit: Sago pudding is a milk dessert made from palm starch.

clue.text: Who's abandoned seat in bar?

indicators.note: abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: anagram fodder
anagram fodder
anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Who has given up a stool at the pub counter?
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the anagram and the definition: a teetotaller gives up his bar stool.
explanation.definitionFit: An abstainer refuses alcohol, so has no need of a seat in a bar.

clue.text: Italian with alluring air oddly rejected

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters are thrown out, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: An Italian with a seductive manner is turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: Luigi is a typical Italian male first name.

clue.text: Lugubrious donkey's slightly rearranged hideous thing

indicators.note: slightly rearranged means a few letters are shifted into a new order

parts.note: Eeyore is the gloomy donkey in Winnie-the-Pooh; the possessive gives an S

explanation.surface: A gloomy donkey's face is rearranged into something ugly.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyesore is something very ugly to look at.

clue.text: Trap for criminals set by volunteers, getting a nibble

indicators.note: set by means one piece is placed next to the other

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
a sting is a police operation to trap criminals

explanation.surface: Volunteers set a trap for criminals who take the bait.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA is the Territorial Army, the British Army's part-time reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasting food means taking a small bite of it.
